adminOnly.title: Administrators only
adminOnly.body: Model providers decide what this instance remembers and where its content is sent, so only an administrator can change them.

list.heading: Model providers
list.explainer: Every endpoint this instance can reach. Several of the same kind are normal, so the name is what tells them apart.
list.error: The providers could not be loaded.

empty.title: No providers yet
empty.body: Add the endpoint that serves your models. Nothing is sent anywhere until a tier is assigned to it.

list.cannotDelete: Reassign the tiers this provider serves before removing it.

anthropic.name: Anthropic
anthropic.subtitle: The hosted Anthropic API. No embeddings.

self_hosted.name: Self-hosted
self_hosted.subtitle: llama.cpp, Ollama, vLLM, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint

ollama.name: Self-hosted
ollama.subtitle: A local Ollama runtime, carried over from this instance's earlier configuration

managed.locked: This provider is part of your hosting plan. Its endpoint and key are maintained for you and cannot be changed or removed here; every other provider on this page stays yours.

type.legend: What kind of endpoint is this?

label.label: Name
label.help: Your own name for this endpoint. It has to be unique, because two of the same kind are ordinary.

baseUrl.label: Endpoint
baseUrl.hint: Reached from inside the containers, so localhost means the container itself. A server running on this host is at host.docker.internal or the bridge gateway address; another service in this stack is at its service name.

apiKey.label: API key
apiKey.help: Encrypted before it is stored and never shown again. A self-hosted endpoint with no authentication needs none.

assignment.heading: What each tier runs on
assignment.explainer: Four independent choices. A mixed configuration is ordinary: extraction on one endpoint, answers on another.
assignment.error: The configuration could not be loaded.
assignment.partialList: This endpoint may serve models it does not advertise, so type the name if it is not in the list.
assignment.listUnavailable: The model list could not be read ({{reason}}), so type the name instead.
assignment.visionOptional: Leave this unassigned if this instance reads no images. Pages that need vision are then labelled as such rather than arriving empty.

tierHelp.pipeline: Reads documents and verifies every fact
tierHelp.answer: Writes what people read in chat
tierHelp.embeddings: Turns facts into the search index

summary.managedHere: Managed here, in this instance's database. The environment file carries no model configuration.

trust.notEvaluatedHelp: No published measurement matches this exact combination, so nothing is known about how accurately it extracts. Accuracy is never borrowed from a different configuration.

embeddings.locked: The embeddings model cannot be assigned directly. Every stored fact was turned into a vector by the current one, and searching a mix of two would quietly return the wrong results.
embeddings.interim: The managed rebuild is unavailable in this process. Change the model with the operator command {{command}}, which re-embeds everything from the database.

answerOptions.heading: Answer models people may choose
answerOptions.explainer: The answer model is the one anybody may pick for themselves, from this list. Extraction, embeddings and vision stay administrator decisions.
answerOptions.empty: Nobody can choose their own answer model yet. Add one here and it appears in everyone's settings.
answerOptions.label: Shown as

history.heading: Configuration history
history.explainer: Every change, and the configuration identifier it produced. This is the identifier a published measurement is matched by.

userChoice.heading: Your answer model
userChoice.explainer: Which model writes the answers you read. It changes nothing about what is remembered or how it is found.
userChoice.none: Your administrator has not offered a choice here yet.

rebuild.planTitle: Changing the embeddings model rebuilds the whole index
rebuild.planWhat: Embeddings move to {{model}} on {{provider}}, producing {{dimensions}}-dimension vectors. The probe just confirmed the model works.
rebuild.planCost: {{facts}} memories will be re-embedded: an estimated {{tokens}} tokens, taking roughly {{duration}}.
rebuild.planSpend: This is real model spend, metered against the daily model budget. If the budget runs out mid-rebuild, the rebuild pauses and resumes by itself.
rebuild.planServing: Search keeps answering from the current index for the whole rebuild. The switch happens only when the new index is verified complete, and it is instant.
rebuild.planEvaluated: The resulting configuration {{configuration}} has published trust scores.
rebuild.planNotEvaluated: The resulting configuration {{configuration}} is not evaluated: no published trust scores match it.
rebuild.progress: {{done}} of {{total}} memories re-embedded, about {{tokens}} tokens spent.
rebuild.servingNote: Search keeps answering from the current index; nothing changes until the rebuild completes.
